description: This file contains a unittest-based test case for building and verifying the libepoxy library using Meson and Ninja. It includes setup, download, extraction, configuration, build, and installation steps, as well as checking for specific build features and for ELF files.

classes.name: EpoxyTest
classes.description: A test case class inheriting from OESDKTestCase, designed to verify the build process of libepoxy with Meson, including configuration, compilation, installation, and ELF file validation.

methods.name: setUp(self)
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by checking if the necessary host package 'nativesdk-meson' is installed; skips the test if not.

methods.name: test_epoxy(self)
methods.description: Performs the download, extraction, configuration, build, and installation of libepoxy, then verifies the built ELF library is present.
